subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry - Lesson 10: Oblique Triangle Navigation Task
description: Apply the Law of Sines and Law of Cosines in a multi-step route-planning task involving landmarks, bearings, distances, and a final navigation recommendation.
learningObjectives: Draw an accurate navigation diagram from landmark bearings and distances
Determine included angles in a two-leg route using forward bearings and back bearings
Choose the Law of Cosines or Law of Sines based on the information available
Compute direct distance and final bearing in a multi-step oblique-triangle task
Interpret calculated results in a clear route-planning explanation
prerequisites: Bearing notation measured clockwise from north
Back bearings found by adding or subtracting 180 degrees
Rounding distances and angles to a stated precision
